# Step 6: Finding and annotating the available genome with prokka

Gene prediction as a process can be studies and clarified using prokka because it helps you predict genomic varieties such as protein-coding genes, tRNAs, rRNAs and other functional elements for the sustenance of the bacteria 

Utilization of the prokka programme compares the current set of predicted genes that have been run against the previously curated database of known homologous genes to assign it a gene name and biological function wherever it is possible

```bash
alias prokka='apptainer run -B /pvol/:/pvol /pvol/data/sif/prokka.sif prokka'

 prokka --outdir $bin --prefix $bin "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa";

done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```
